free_tier_limits: No forever-free production plan. Free trial available on paid plans (Foundation/Scale include ~1-month trial); sandbox for testing. Paid plans start at Basic (~$15/mo for 10k emails/mo). Confirm current allotments on mailgun.com/pricing.
description: Mailgun (Sinch) is a developer-focused email delivery platform with a REST API for sending transactional and bulk email, inbound parsing/routing, templates, webhooks, suppressions, and analytics. US and EU regions are available; API access uses HTTP Basic Auth with private API keys. No forever-free production tier; paid plans start at Basic (~$15/mo for 10,000 emails/mo) with free trials on higher tiers.
